Movement, social geometry and spatial occupancy

Source: vignettes/articles/movement-and-schooling.Rmd
movement-and-schooling.Rmd

Movement and school geometry

Fish trajectories contain an ordered sequence of observed positions. A path’s measured length is therefore a supported observed distance, not necessarily the animal’s true distance traveled through occlusions.

Core movement analysis 

library(aquaTrajectories)
set.seed(34)
tracks <- aqt_simulate_tracks(n_fish = 5, n_frames = 200)
kin <- aqt_kinematics(tracks, max_gap_s = 0.1)
paths <- aqt_path_summary(tracks, max_gap_s = 0.1)
school <- aqt_group_metrics(tracks, max_gap_s = 0.1)
aqt_plot_paths(tracks)

The simulated paths above are not real fish. In actual video analysis, annotate skipped frames, variable PTS and long support gaps explicitly.

Spatial group metrics

  • aqt_group_pairwise_distances(): simultaneous observed pairwise fish positions.
  • aqt_group_spatial_summary(): geometry and group spatial spread.
  • aqt_group_spatial_edges(): threshold-defined proximity networks, not inferred friendships or dominance.
  • aqt_zone_occupancy(): user-defined observed 2D zones.
  • aqt_voxel_occupancy(): observed 3D voxel occupancy, when physical XYZ is valid.
  • aqt_voxel_entropy(): conditional occupancy entropy over declared cells.

Path shape and recurrence

aqt_trajectory_dtw() and aqt_trajectory_dtw_matrix() compute time-warped distances under declared assumptions. aqt_trajectory_recurrence() quantifies observed-position recurrence with radius and temporal exclusion rules.

Dense-grid principal components appear in aqt_trajectory_grid_pca(). Irregular sparse sampling is a separate estimation problem handled in aqt_sparse_fpca_fit() where fdapace is available.

Visual displays

Find aqt_plot_paths(), aqt_plot_school_dynamics(), aqt_plot_school3d() and aqt_plot_voxel3d() in the visualization reference.

Proximity alone is not evidence of leadership, preference, stress or positive welfare.
